findings.title: Menu selection resolves against mutable live options, not rendered snapshot
findings.message: The suggestion event is built from the live c.Options at callback time. That slice is shared with the owner and may be changed or reordered after View. A menu rendered with an older snapshot can then resolve to a different label, and the controlled-menu test confirms this lookup is stale-prone. Using the snapshot would give consistent, predictable behavior. Combined with the Disabled check, a rendered enabled option that becomes disabled is silently ignored.
findings.suggestion: Capture a copy of options at View time and look up the selected option in that snapshot (or deliberately validate against both), so the semantics are explicit.
